title: Pull a Card
subtitle: Every pull is a verified, graded asset.

choose.title: Choose your card
choose.honesty: Your card was drawn the instant you pulled — the pick is yours to enjoy, not to influence.
choose.gridAria: Twelve face-down cards to choose from

peel.aria: Sleeve covering your card. Drag it up, down, left or right — or press an arrow key — to uncover the card.

pending.title: Checking your pull
pending.body: Your last pull didn't confirm — this can happen if your connection dropped. You have not been charged twice; it's safe to check status or retry.
pending.notCharged: No charge went through. Safe to try again.
pending.stillChecking: Still working on it — check again in a moment.
pending.refunded: That pull could not be filled, so you were refunded.

topUp.message: Not enough balance for another pull.

errors.buybackFailed: Couldn't sell this card. Try again from your Vault.
